name: Point Zero
description: Spin-off from Politecnico di Torino developing ZEDS, a patented zero-emission braking and propulsion system integrating an in-wheel electric motor with a magnetorheological brake.

newsAboutCompany.title: Point Zero wins Premio 2031 Primo Round Award
newsAboutCompany.summary: Recognized for its innovative zero-emission braking system ZEDS.

newsAboutCompany.title: Selected for Motor Valley Accelerator 2024
newsAboutCompany.summary: Received ~€400K convertible note investment and mentorship from Plug and Play/CDP VC program.

faqs.question: When was Point Zero founded?
faqs.answer: Point Zero was incorporated in November 2024 as a Politecnico di Torino spin-off.

faqs.question: What is Point Zero’s core technology?
faqs.answer: The Zero-Emissions Driving System (ZEDS): an integrated in-wheel motor and magnetorheological brake that eliminates particulate emissions from braking.
